invariants.rationale: The method uses order.getQuantity() and order.getUnitPrice(), requiring order to be non-null for safe execution.
Order quantity is often non-negative; negative quantities usually do not make sense in the context of orders.
Unit price of an order is typically non-negative in conventional business and e-commerce settings.
Order quantity usually represents a whole number of items, implying it should be an integer value.
An order is only eligible for discount if it makes sense (such as quantity > 0); expressing this as a logical implication captures potential business logic.
